Start date: 1004-07-23  
40 weeks = 280 days.  
Add 2 more days → total 282 days.  

1004 is a leap year (divisible by 4, Gregorian rules apply).  
July 23 + 282 days:  
July has 31 days → remaining in July: 8 days (23 to 31).  
282 − 8 = 274 days left.  
August (31) → 274 − 31 = 243  
September (30) → 243 − 30 = 213  
October (31) → 213 − 31 = 182  
November (30) → 182 − 30 = 152  
December (31) → 152 − 31 = 121  
January 1005 (31) → 121 − 31 = 90  
February 1005 (28, not leap in 1005) → 90 − 28 = 62  
March (31) → 62 − 31 = 31  
April (30) → 31 − 30 = 1  
May 1, 1005 → add the remaining 1 day → May 2, 1005.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1005-05-02
